question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word from the given sentence.

She recieved an award for her outstanding performance.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. 'recieved'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"recieved"** is incorrectly spelt; the correct spelling is "received". (प्राप्त किया)

 
 
• **Example: **She received an award for her outstanding performance.
 
 

 
• **"Received"** refers to being given or presented with something. (प्राप्त किया)

 
 
• **Example: **He received a letter from his old friend yesterday.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. 'recieved'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Award** (पुरस्कार): A prize or other mark of recognition given in honor of an achievement.

 
 
• **Example:** She won an award for her excellent research work.
 
 

 
• **Performance** (प्रदर्शन): The action or process of performing a task or function.

 
 
• **Example: **His performance in the play was outstanding.
 
 

 
• **Outstanding** (उत्कृष्ट): Exceptionally good.

 
 
• **Example:** She did an outstanding job on the project.
